data.name: RG_STEEL_01
data.value: Nothing.[pause=30] No cold,[pause=10] no tremor,[pause=10] not a sound.[pause=25] Just an empty chamber.

data.name: RG_STEEL_02
data.value: ...That's what bothers me.[pause=25] The other two announced themselves.[pause=20] This one,[pause=15] didn't.

data.name: RG_STEEL_03
data.value: (The dust on the floor isn't even.[pause=20] Something has been standing in the same spot for a very long time.)

data.name: RG_STEEL_04
data.value: I DID NOT SLEEP.[pause=30] I STOOD WHILE THE OTHER TWO RESTED.[pause=25] SOMEONE HAD TO WATCH THE DOOR.

data.name: RG_STEEL_05
data.value: He was here...[pause=25] all along.[pause=20] We turned our backs on him walking in.

data.name: RG_STEEL_06
data.value: THE COLD FORGOT.[pause=25] THE STONE COUNTED.[pause=25] I,[pause=20] I WATCHED.[pause=30] IT IS THE WORST OF THE THREE DUTIES.

data.name: RG_STEEL_07
data.value: I WAS NEVER TOLD WHAT I WATCHED FOR.[pause=30] ONLY NOT TO LOOK AWAY.[pause=25] PROVE THAT I MAY,[pause=20] FOR AN INSTANT.

data.name: RG_STEEL_08
data.value: An instant,[pause=20] then.[pause=25] Just long enough for us to pass.[pause=20] After that, you can look elsewhere.

data.name: RG_STEEL_09
data.value: ...I LOOKED AWAY.[pause=30] NOTHING CAME OUT.[pause=25] A THOUSAND YEARS DREADING AN INSTANT THAT NEVER CAME.[pause=30] GO DOWN.[pause=20] ASK THE GREAT ONE WHAT HE TRULY GUARDED.

data.name: RG_STEEL_10
data.value: "The great one"...[pause=25] There's a fourth,[pause=20] further down.[pause=25] And he knows.

data.name: RG_STEEL_11
data.value: I DID NOT LOOK AWAY.[pause=30] NOR WILL YOU,[pause=20] NEXT TIME.

data.name: RG_VICTOIRE
data.value: The guardian goes still.[pause=25] No crack,[pause=15] no collapse:[pause=20] it simply stands straighter than before,[pause=15] as if relieved of a weight.

data.name: RG_VICTOIRE_P
data.value: Where it kept watch,[pause=20] the stone has split.[pause=25] Steps descend into the dark.

data.name: RG_DEFAITE
data.value: The floor gives way.[pause=25] The guardian doesn't pursue:[pause=15] it simply returns to its post,[pause=10] and waits.

data.name: RG_DEFAITE_P
data.value: We got thrown out...[pause=20] but it didn't finish us.[pause=25] It's waiting for us to come back ready.[pause=20] So let's go back.
